about: Fixed, reviewed inputs of the bootstrap generation contract. The harness stages, pins and checks against these before the seed step; changing any value is a reviewed contract change.

qualified_host.reason: The knot_io host freezes Darwin's errno table, so IO error codes are comparable across generations only on Darwin (FX-27).

memory_maximum.meaning: The largest linear memory a Knot-built module or image may declare; exhausting it is Exhausted (heap), a Knot budget, on every host.

reserved_flags.source: .toolchain/bend-2.0.29-574b6d3/bend2/comp.ts: the native main() and the JS cli() consume these before IO.args, so a seed-built C1 and a Knot-built A2 would see different argv.

excluded_metadata: dates and wall-clock times: measurements.elapsed_seconds is recorded outside the contract
peak RSS: measurements.peak_rss_bytes is recorded outside the contract
KNOT_GATE_TIMEOUT_SCALE and every timeout budget derived from it
absolute paths, including the sandbox location and BEND_LIB's location
hostname, user and environment variables other than the recorded runtime and build identity
the executor of each step (seed-built C1 or Knot-built A2), which each stage records instead
